verdict.rationale: Svelte's docs say `.svelte.js`/`.svelte.ts` files let you share reactive state across your app (svelte-docs-12), using the built-in `$state` rune (svelte-docs-5, svelte-docs-8) and getter functions to read current values (svelte-docs-20). A community user independently praises the built-in Stores and Context system for sharing state (svelte-comm-5), so no third-party library is needed. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on global-state patterns (context API usage, SSR-safe shared state), and hands-on corroboration that covers the newer runes-based approach rather than older stores.
